dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: #It's you, {NICKNAME}. I never thought I'd see you again here in Snezhnograd. What a pleasant surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hm? You're the one from The Chasm...

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Anton. Anton of the Ninth Company. Thank you for helping us back then, my friend.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: I'm on leave at the moment. If there's anything I can help you with, just say the word.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Thank you, my friend. I wish you safe travels as well.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: They are well enough. Danila, Temur, Radomir, and the rest of my soldiers are all still alive. They are currently recovering in Glupov.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: What happened in The Chasm took a great deal out of them, but fortunately, the Ninth Company remains intact. We did not bring shame upon our ancestors or Her Majesty.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Once everyone has recovered their strength, we will be ready for new orders at any time. Until Her Majesty's great wish is fulfilled, we may die, but we will not be broken.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: No news. But perhaps... no news is the best news.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: Katya and Kolya... They are children of the House of the Hearth. They value the bonds of family far more than we do.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: If they are still alive, I hope they never come back here.

dialogues.speaker: Antoine
dialogues.text: I believe that they deserted the Fatui, escaped somewhere safe, and survived. So for me... no news is the best news. I can still believe that.
